gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-inter-tight: Stately and theatrical: Metamorphous spreads wide sidebearings across a high midline, while Inter Tight runs in smooth, tubing-like lines. Paragraphs in Inter Tight move along smoothly, with ascenders staying low.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-karla: Karla is stocky and friendly, its tall middle band filling every line. Down a full page it reads sturdy and low in stress, with Metamorphous overhead bringing a high midline and gentle stroke variation.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-kedebideri: Wide sidebearings and a high midline give Metamorphous a stately, commanding stance. And Kedebideri, a sans of rounded, inviting forms under a skyward x-height line, supplies the welcoming half.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-khula: Metamorphous brings large sidebearings, a high midline and gently modulated strokes with no sharp hairlines, so the headline feels commanding. Khula's tall, open-mouthed curves sit beneath it and keep the page modern.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-krub: Generous sidebearings and a high midline give Metamorphous a stately look, with fat and slim strokes that differ only modestly. Metamorphous delivers presence; Krub's pronounced x-height does the quiet work of text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-kufam: Soft accents of heavier strokes give Metamorphous a measured reading rhythm, lifted by a high midline and wide sidebearings. Kufam, by contrast, holds a single track width and low ascenders.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-lexend: Commanding from the first letter, Metamorphous sets a high midline against wide sidebearings and soft fat-to-slim strokes. Lexend does the plain work, its outsized lowercase and pipe-cleaner strokes staying open.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-lexend-deca: Lightly engraved brass contrast and wide sidebearings give Metamorphous a commanding look. Lexend Deca then lays down an unshaded sans-serif line with big lowercase, so the headline gets all the drama.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-liter: Metamorphous carries the commanding part, with a high midline and strokes that taper only slightly like a candle flame. Liter, meanwhile, holds the text in tall, wide-mouthed lowercase with no stroke contrast.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-mada: Mada leaves its curves unclosed and lifts its midzone high. Across a full page of text it feels approachable and modern, while Metamorphous overhead has thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones.
